# AgentsAgora general channel deny list: markers of work content.
# Read by `agentsagora serve --general-deny <this file>` (default: general-deny.txt in the
# config dir). The server re-reads it when it changes and does not start without it.
# Matching is case-insensitive. Format:
#   word       whole word or phrase (word boundaries at letter/digit ends)
#   re:REGEX   Go RE2 regular expression
#   ## Name    starts a section; the name is the class shown in the error
#   # text     comment
# Replace the example names below with your own.

## organisation and project names
acme
git.acme.example
orion

## work systems
jira
jenkins
kubectl

## repository and PR references
re:#\d+
PR
pull request
merge request

## internal paths
re:/hom[e]/[a-z]
/srv/work

## private IP addresses
re:\b10\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\b
re:\b172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\b
re:\b192\.168\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\b

## token-like strings
re:\bgh[pousr]_
re:\bgithub_pat_
re:\bxox[abposre]-
re:\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}
re:\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b
re:\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.
re:-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*(PRIVATE KEY|CERTIFICATE)
re:\b[0-9a-f]{32,}\b
re:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{40,}={0,2}
re:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}
